en-US.description: Batch convert plain text lists into individual image files in seconds. Easily customize fonts, colors, and backgrounds without complex editors.
en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Text to Image Converter is a streamlined utility designed to instantly transform lists of plain text into individual image files. Perfect for batch processing, this tool eliminates the need to manually create graphics in complex editors. Simply paste a list of text, choose a color or custom background image, customize your layout, and let the software automatically generate a dedicated image for every line of text in seconds.

With its intuitive interface, you can customize fonts, colors, and layouts to ensure your message stands out. It’s the perfect time-saving solution for users who need to generate text-based visuals without the steep learning curve of high-end graphic design suites.

Speed up your workflow with the built-in batch conversion feature. Instead of creating images one by one, you can load a text file containing hundreds of lines. The software will automatically process each line as a separate image file, applying your chosen background and font settings to the entire set with a single click.

* One-Click Generation: Create images instantly without manual editing.
* Customization Options: Full control over text fonts, background images, and colors.
* Shape Support: Supports Circle, Rectangle, and Rounded Rectangle overlays.
* Wide Format Support: Export your creations in all popular formats, including PNG, WebP, JPEG, TIFF, GIF, and BMP.
* No Image Editor Required: Say goodbye to the complexity of Photoshop or GIMP for simple text-to-image tasks.

Key Features:
* Text to PNG
* Text to WEBP
* Text to GIF
* Text to JPG
* Text to TIF
* Text to BMP
